thread:
Maya AE: hey @Jon — spinning up a POC with Acme, they want 50% off Dedicated for 6 months. they also want a soft commit of $120k. can we do this without VP approval?
Jon SalesOps: do you have the expected TCV and whether commit is firm? 50% is pretty far outside standard rate card. usually >40% needs deal desk review, >60% needs VP.
Maya AE: commit is soft (they'll try to hit $120k if POC goes well). timeline: start in 2 weeks, 6mo POC. no SOW yet.
Priya DealDesk: pinging in — quick summary of current rules: auto-approve discounts up to 20% for self-serve. 21-40% requires DealDesk review + standard exec signoff for special terms. >40% typically requires a documented business case and VP sign-off, unless there's a short-term promotional addendum anchored to a commit. for POC-specific exceptions we do 'POC addendum' process — need approved SOW-like addendum and a holdback clause.
Theo SE: technical note — if this is Dedicated capacity we need to mark the opportunity for "dedicated_pool_required" so capacity planning knows. also add a field for "poc_duration_months" so infra can flag provisioning windows.
Priya DealDesk: Maya, please add these custom SFDC/CPQ fields to the quote before routing: discount_pct__c, discount_approval_level__c, committed_spend__c, poc_addendum_required__c, dedicated_pool_required__c, and special_terms_summary__c. set discount_approval_level__c=3 for >40% so routing goes to DealDesk queue.
Maya AE: copying a small CPQ snippet Theo suggested — will paste into the quote config:
```
Opportunity custom fields:
  discount_pct__c: 50
  discount_approval_level__c: 3
  committed_spend__c: 120000
  poc_duration_months__c: 6
  poc_addendum_required__c: true
  dedicated_pool_required__c: true
  special_terms_summary__c: "6mo trial, 120k soft commit, limited liability, no data residency changes"
```
Jon SalesOps: routing logic we want: if discount_approval_level__c == 3 -> route to /queues/deal-desk; SLA 2 business days. if committed_spend__c >= 200000 -> escalate to VP via approval step. Also set auto-populated approval checklist to include Security Q, SOW addendum, and Exec Biz Case.
Sam Legal: I'll need a draft POC addendum. for 6 months + soft commit i can accept a liability cap limited to fees paid during the POC and a termination clause at 30 days. please attach customer's MSSQL if they request data exports.
Maya AE: adding opp link: https://redwood.salesforce.com/0065g00000XXXXX — quote in CPQ is ready to edit.
deal-desk-bot: Ticket created: DD-4721. Assigned to Priya DealDesk. SLA: 2 business days (2025-11-21T17:00:00Z). Attachments: none.
Priya DealDesk: thanks. next steps Maya: attach a 1-page POC addendum draft to the quote, set the CPQ fields (snippet above), and mark the approval reason as "strategic POC — potential enterprise" in special_terms_summary__c. once done I'll triage and route to Legal if needed.
Jon SalesOps: for tracking, add a record in the Discount Exceptions dashboard with category=PocTrial and tag=dedicated. i'll follow up to make sure routing rules pick this up.
Maya AE: done — fields set and addendum uploaded. ping me if you need more detail.
Priya DealDesk: received, starting review. will flag any missing security items to Sam. expect first response within SLA. if we need VP loop i'll escalate. :thumbsup:
Sam Legal: noted — i'll prepare a short addendum template and post to the thread once ready.
Maya AE: appreciate it. final ask — can we get a one-line internal summary for the AM/CS handoff after approval?
Priya DealDesk: will draft handoff bullet points after approval with commit thresholds, expiration, and renewal path.
Jon SalesOps: closing loop — once DealDesk approves, run CPQ approval flow and push to e-sign. I'll monitor metrics and tag the dashboard.
Maya AE: thanks team :heart:
